\centering
\caption{Sequence-conditioned ensemble prediction tools evaluated.}
\label{tab:tools}
\small
\begin{tabularx}{\textwidth}{@{}l X@{}}
\toprule
Tool & Description \\
\midrule
\textit{Generative} & \\
\specialrule{\lightrulewidth}{0pt}{0pt}
\bioemu \cite{Lewis2025BioEmu}            & Boltzmann emulator producing equilibrium ensemble samples directly from sequence. \\
\esmflow \cite{Jing2024AlphaFlow}         & ESMFold-based flow matching; single-sequence (no MSA).  Originally \alphaflow-ESM-PDB. \\
\alphaflow \cite{Jing2024AlphaFlow}       & AlphaFold-based flow matching; requires an MSA.  Originally \alphaflow-PDB. \\
\esmdiff \cite{Lu2025ESMDiff}             & ESM-based diffusion model over protein backbones. \\
\midrule
\textit{MSA perturbation} & \\
\specialrule{\lightrulewidth}{0pt}{0pt}
\cfrandom \cite{Lee2025CFrandom}          & ColabFold with random MSA subsampling to expose alternative AlphaFold2 modes. \\
\afsampletwo \cite{Kalakoti2025AFsample2} & AlphaFold2 sampler with stratified MSA depth subsampling and dropout. \\
\afsamplethree \cite{kalakoti2026afsample3} & AlphaFold3 sampler with MSA column masking and seed sampling. \\
\speachaf \cite{Stein2022SPEACHAF}        & AF2 with in silico alanine substitution of MSA residues. \\
\bottomrule
\end{tabularx}
\end{table}
